summary: PRF Technologies Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing a Standby Equity Purchase Agreement with YA II PN, LTD. (Yorkville), granting the company the right to sell up to $10 million of ordinary shares over 36 months at 97% of the lowest three-day VWAP. A commitment fee of 1% is payable in installments (partly in shares) plus a $25,000 structuring fee. Yorkville's ownership is capped at 9.99%. This is an ordinary equity line facility, not a special situation, as it involves routine capital raising with no change of control or strategic event. No deal terms are applicable.
